title: LanguaTalk Slow French: Learn French With Gaëlle | French podcast for A2-B1
author: LanguaTalk.com
description: Learn French with Gaëlle, an experienced French teacher. 99% in French and designed for students with a basic level (A2) or lower intermediate (B1). Gaëlle speaks slowly to make it easier to understand. If you have an intermediate level, you can always increase the playback speed in your app. Each week, you’ll improve your French whilst also learning about French culture, society, history, and much more. Go to LanguaTalk.com/frenchpod to read an interactive transcript of each episode as you listen. This will help you follow along and allow you to study the sentences.

episodes_recents.titre: Le Familistère de Guise - utopie sociale ouvrière
Comment vont les artistes et la culture en France
La ville de Grass et l’industrie des parfums
Les espaces sans enfants en France

extraits.texte: I find this to be incredibly helpful! Gaele speaks French at just the right tone and speed to allow me to comprehend what she is saying. I’ve been listening for the last few months and already I understand more and more every time I listen.

The worst part of learning a language is being indoctrinated by a woke and leftist movement. It seems that there is no other way to learn French without those woke themes! It is tiring and annoying. That's why I cancelled the langua talk subscription.…

I am a beginner/intermediate French speaker, taking lessons in a small group. I cannot keep up with normal-paced French podcasts, but I can understand this one. And the topics are very interesting. I straight-up enjoy it!
